worldcombat.skill.junglehealing.summary: Vines and sprouts surround the user and nearby allies, healing them and clearing major status conditions. Natural ground improves healing and radius; deep roots strengthen both with longer windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.junglehealing.use.0: Heal a group of allies and cure them together
worldcombat.skill.junglehealing.use.1: Cleanse a whole party at once on natural ground
worldcombat.skill.junglehealing.descript: When the vines wrap in, the user and each ally restore %1$s of their maximum health; a closer bond draws the jungle in, and natural ground underfoot feeds it further.
Vines reach %1$s blocks, accompanied by about %2$s sprout particles.
About %1$s leaf motes; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s and cooldown %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.junglehealing.stance.d: Deep Roots: x1.2 vine radius, x1.1 healing, x1.4 sprouts, at the cost of +3 ticks of wind-up and a longer cooldown - for rescuing a whole group.
worldcombat.skill.junglehealing.stance.s: Shallow Roots: a faster wind-up and a shorter cooldown with a smaller ring and fewer sprouts - for a quick cleanse.
worldcombat.skill.junglehealing.timing: Cast on yourself; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.junglehealing.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.junglehealing.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.junglehealing.preferen: On: x1.2 radius, x1.1 healing and x1.4 sprouts with a +3 tick wind-up and a longer cooldown. Off: faster and cheaper, but a smaller ring and fewer sprouts.
The jungle is called when the user or an ally is below this health ratio; lower keeps attacking, higher heals at the first wound.
The jungle is considered only for a subject within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher closes a gap first.
